description: Li Wei helps Mr. Zhang choose a bed, mattress, wardrobe, and bedside tables for a bedroom.
visual_style: See style-guide.md for full consistency rules

scenes.description: Mr. Zhang explains the size and needs of his bedroom.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Before I recommend bedroom furniture, may I ask about your room size?
lines.zh: 在推荐卧室家具前，我可以问一下您的房间尺寸吗？

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: The bedroom is about twelve square meters, and I need more storage.
lines.zh: 卧室大约十二平方米，我需要更多收纳。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Then we should balance comfort, storage, and walking space.
lines.zh: 那我们要平衡舒适、收纳和走动空间。

scenes.description: They compare queen and king size beds.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Should I choose a queen size bed or a king size bed?
lines.zh: 我应该选标准双人床还是特大双人床？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: For twelve square meters, a queen size bed will leave more space.
lines.zh: 十二平方米的话，标准双人床会留下更多空间。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: That makes sense. I do not want the room to feel too tight.
lines.zh: 有道理。我不想让房间感觉太挤。

scenes.description: Li Wei explains mattress firmness and support.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: This mattress is medium firm, so it supports your back without feeling hard.
lines.zh: 这款床垫是中等偏硬，可以支撑背部但不会感觉太硬。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: I usually sleep on my side. Is it suitable for me?
lines.zh: 我通常侧睡。它适合我吗？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Yes. It relieves pressure on your shoulders and hips.
lines.zh: 适合。它能减轻肩膀和髋部压力。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: It feels supportive but not stiff.

scenes.description: They discuss wardrobe doors, shelves, and hanging space.

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: I need a wardrobe with enough hanging space for coats.
lines.zh: 我需要一个有足够挂衣空间放外套的衣柜。

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: This one has sliding doors, shelves, and two hanging rails.
lines.zh: 这款有推拉门、层板和两根挂衣杆。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Sliding doors are better because the aisle is narrow.
lines.zh: 推拉门更好，因为过道比较窄。

scenes.description: Li Wei recommends bedside tables and a reading lamp.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: I suggest two bedside tables with drawers for small items.
lines.zh: 我建议配两个带抽屉的床头柜，用来放小物件。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: Can one side include a reading lamp?

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Yes. We have a matching lamp with warm adjustable light.
lines.zh: 可以。我们有一款配套灯，暖光可以调节。

scenes.description: They summarize the bedroom furniture plan.

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: So the plan is a queen bed, a medium firm mattress, a wardrobe, and two bedside tables.
lines.zh: 所以方案是标准双人床、中等偏硬床垫、衣柜和两个床头柜。

lines.speaker: Mr. Zhang
lines.en: That sounds complete. Can you prepare a quotation for this bedroom set?
lines.zh: 听起来很完整。您能为这套卧室家具准备报价吗？

lines.speaker: Li Wei
lines.en: Of course. I will list each item and the total price clearly.
lines.zh: 当然。我会清楚列出每件产品和总价。
